admission.justification: The five members jointly distinguish setup and foundation ownership from optional onboarding work: card format and measured fixer admission govern authored cards, baseline admission refuses legacy cards, ordered setup permits scaffold-only adoption, and c-03 handoff prevents card/baseline state from being mistaken for knowledge. Each member applies under its own conditions rather than executing on every setup path.

guarantee: Converted-memory setup attributes the first baseline before new-root foundation authoring and reports the actual knowledge state for an Architect-owned task, without making onboarding a setup prerequisite. When onboarding is authored, converted card shape, admitted fixer authority and the prohibition on legacy-format first-baseline cards apply; the c-03 handoff retains its clean-fixer and actual-state account. Neither cards nor an attributed baseline establish an authored knowledge foundation.
title: converted-first-baseline-with-truthful-handoff
